segments.title: ERD Studio · Issue #133
segments.subtitle: A relationship lives with the fact, however you draw it
segments.say: Issue one thirty-three. A relationship was saved in whichever model you drew it from, so a new fact meant editing its dimensions.

cues.caption: Three models on the canvas, and no relationships yet.
Drag from the customer key to the order's customer column.
The dialog turns it round, and says it will be saved in the fact's file.
It lives with the fact, as many to one.
New: a relationship can carry a role, like ship date.
Drag the date key to the ship date column, and name it.
The role is drawn on the line.

segments.title: Upgrading from 1.6.7
segments.subtitle: Projects saved the old way
segments.say: And for a project saved by the previous version.

segments.title: $ erd-studio check
segments.say: The new check command flags both relationships saved the old way.

cues.caption: A project saved by version 1.6.7, before this change.
The dimension holds the relationship, and its key was flagged as a foreign key.
ERD Studio offers to tidy it up. Nothing changes until you confirm.
One preview lists every change, and anything that needs you.
Repaired in one step. The diagram draws the same lines.
Both relationships now live with the fact, as many to one.
And the dimension is back to just its own columns.

segments.title: $ erd-studio check
segments.say: After the repair, the check is clean.

segments.title: What else changed
bullets: One rule for when two relationships are the same: either way round, everywhere
Saving never drops an entry it could not read; old files still render
erd-studio check, doctor and diff report problems with stable codes
AI helper files, setup skill and docs; Data Vault and Kimball both covered
segments.say: Behind the scenes: every part of ERD Studio now agrees on when two relationships are the same. Saving never drops what it could not read, and old files still render. A new check command reports problems with stable codes, and the AI helper files teach the same rules.

segments.title: Ready for review
bullets: Saved with the model holding the foreign key
Older projects are offered a one-step, previewed repair
An optional role label on each link
segments.say: Relationships now live with the fact, older projects get a one-step repair, and a link can carry a role.
